archives.open.says: Opening the archives that hold some of the pod's files: reading the directory at the end of each, never the files it holds.

archives.write.says: Writing the files a step adds as archives: each archive's bytes written under another name and flushed to storage, then renamed to its name. One archive replaces a file for each of its files.

counts.archives.opened: How many archives of the pod's files were opened, each by reading its directory alone.
counts.archives.entries: How many files those archives' directories list.
counts.archives.entries.read: How many files were read out of an archive, each by one read of its part of the archive.
counts.archives.written: How many archives of the pod's files were written: one for each step that adds files an archive may hold, more where a step's files pass what one archive may hold.
counts.archives.subject.left: How many loose copies of the subject's file were left in place after their archive was written, because removing them failed; the next step removes them.
counts.archives.entries.written: How many files those archives were written with, which the host did not write as files of their own.
